cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Retirement ≠ career – the period of life after stopping official work.

p.em: Example: Many people plan their retirement carefully.

cosy-blockquote.p: Pension ≠ salary – a regular payment made by the state or company after stopping work.

p.em: Example: He receives his pension every month.

cosy-blockquote.p: Save ≠ spend – to keep money for future use.

p.em: Example: It is wise to save money when you are young.

cosy-blockquote.p: Workplace ≠ home – the building or place where people do their jobs.

p.em: Example: She misses her friends at the workplace.

cosy-blockquote.p: Freedom ≠ obligation – the state of being able to act without control by others.

p.em: Example: Retirement offers freedom to travel.
Example: A healthy daily routine keeps seniors active.

cosy-blockquote.p: Boredom ≠ excitement – the feeling of having nothing interesting to do.

p.em: Example: He joined a gardening club to avoid boredom.

cosy-blockquote.p: Budget ≠ waste – a plan of how to spend money.

p.em: Example: A monthly budget helps manage expenses.

cosy-blockquote.p: Schedule ≠ surprise – a plan that gives expected times for activities.

p.em: Example: I keep a light schedule on weekends.

cosy-blockquote.p: Active ≠ passive – doing things and moving regularly.

p.em: Example: Staying active is good for your health.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
At what age do people usually enter retirement in your country?
★ What do you plan to do when you stop working full-time?

How does a state or personal pension support older adults financially?
★ Do young people save for pensions early in your country?

Why is it important to save money every month for the future?
★ Do you use a savings account or investment app?

What do you like or dislike about your current workplace?
★ Do you prefer working from home or in an office?

What does true personal freedom mean to you after finishing your career?
★ What hobby would you pursue with total free time?

Why is having a daily routine helpful during retirement?
★ What is your morning routine on weekends?

How can retired individuals avoid feeling boredom during long days?
★ What activities keep you engaged when you are not working?

How do you plan your monthly budget for living expenses?
★ Are you careful with spending money on non-essentials?

Do you prefer a strict weekly schedule or flexible days?
★ How far in advance do you plan your vacations?

Why is staying physically active important for senior citizens?
★ What exercise or sport do you enjoy doing regularly?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Reaching retirement is the happiest phase of a person's life. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you look forward to retirement?

A government pension should provide enough money for a comfortable life. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Is the pension system in your country reliable?

Learning to save early in your career is more important than earning a high salary. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Did your parents teach you to save money?

Leaving a long-term workplace causes emotional stress for many older workers. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Will you miss working when you retire?

Total personal freedom without work obligations can feel overwhelming after a while. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you need structure to stay happy?

Maintaining a structured routine is vital for mental health at any age. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How do you feel when your routine changes suddenly?

Feeling boredom after retiring is a sign that a person needs new hobbies. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How quickly do you get bored on long vacations?

Following a careful monthly budget allows retirees to travel stress-free. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you track your daily expenses?

Having a fixed daily schedule keeps older adults healthier and happier. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you prefer organized days or total flexibility?

Staying physically active after work ends extends life expectancy significantly. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How many steps do you walk per day?

ul.li: Incorrect: I am go to retire. → Correct: I am going to retire. ((The future intention structure requires 'going to' + base verb.))
Incorrect: He don't work now. → Correct: He doesn't work now. ((3rd person singular negative present simple uses 'doesn't'.))
